description: Streaming composition, negative half of Theorem 6(a).  Histories of K=10 waves in which exactly one wave (index 6) is genuinely bad (Delta = 0.25 > eps = 0.2).  'all-pass' is the sound consensus rule; 'product' multiplies per-wave certificate e-values, the instinctive move the theorem warns against.  A history-wide claim is FALSE here by construction, so any issuance is an error.
